title: Meet Kanav Jain: Scottish student who built a low-cost autonomous aircraft to deliver medicines to remote communities
summary_full: Kanav Jain, a talented Scottish student, has been awarded the prestigious UK Young Engineer of the Year for creating AeroAid, an innovative low-cost autonomous drone aimed at delivering medical supplies. This versatile VTOL quadplane combines the best features of helicopters and airplanes, making it ideal for reaching remote locations. Jain’s mission is to leverage technology for vital humanitarian assistance, reflecting his commitment as a leader in drone technology workshops.
